decisions.reason: This glazed industrial sectional door is very close to the firm's established industrial door and compliance know-how, so under absorptive capacity logic the firm can learn from early market feedback and improve it rather than withdraw it.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door fits especially well with the firm's existing thermal, industrial and customized building-solution capabilities, making it a strong candidate to retain and refine commercially.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door remained prominently presented and builds directly on the firm's core metal-fabrication and sectional-door expertise, management would likely keep it and use internal development capacity to sustain it.
